question: Who is the primordial teacher behind this autonomous shining of consciousness?
premises: The goddess shines clearly in that very autonomous way.
The glorious great lord is the teacher even of earlier teachers.
This lord is identified with that autonomous consciousness.
inference: The autonomous, clearly shining consciousness is the glorious great lord, the primordial teacher of all.
plain_english: And she shines clearly in that very way, autonomous indeed; she is the glorious great lord, the god who is the teacher even of those who came before.
